violations.text: Mold was observed on cooked chourice and peppers and shaved parmesan. Foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw shelled eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as butter and dressings in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

-Calamari above the fill line was observed held at 48-50 degrees Fahrenheit in refrigerant filled pans; calamari under fill line was observed at 38-40 degrees Fahrenheit. Fill line discussed with PIC. Foods were assessed and out of temperature calamari was placed into walk-in cooler to chill. -Various foods in 2 door prep unit were observed held at 45-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods were assessed; time temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of; foods that were recently prepared were placed into walk-in freezer to blast chill. Ambient of unit was ranging from 40 degrees Fahrenheit(top rail) to 44 degrees Fahrenheit (bottom lowboy); Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets for prep unit were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chow mein gravy and RI chowder were observed in the refrigerator in containers covered and greater than four inches deep temping between 76-100 degrees. Lids were removed from foods and foods were placed into ice baths to continue cooling process. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2025

Reduced oxygen packaged lobster was observed at 41 and 42 degrees Fahrenheit stored in the walk-in cooler with the packaging intact. Reduced oxygen packaged seafood must be completely removed from packaging prior to thawing. Lobster was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2025
